summary: IonQ, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of SkyWater Technology via a two-step merger structure (Merger Sub 1 merging into SkyWater, then SkyWater merging into Merger Sub 2), making SkyWater a wholly owned subsidiary. The acquisition creates a vertically integrated full-stack quantum platform company, with SkyWater continuing as a U.S.-based semiconductor foundry. No price per share, premium, or deal value was disclosed in this filing. The merger agreement was originally entered on January 25, 2026. What to watch: integration execution and any remaining regulatory or shareholder-related conditions.
